name: voidr-chrome-extension
description: Capture user sessions for onboarding test generation

scripts.extension:dev: echo 'Open chrome://extensions and Load unpacked → this folder'
scripts.extension:minify:js: npx terser content/content.js -o content/content.min.js && npx terser popup/popup.js -o popup/popup.min.js && npx terser background/background.js -o background/background.min.js
scripts.extension:minify:css: npx cleancss -o content/content.min.css content/content.css && npx cleancss -o popup/popup.min.css popup/popup.css
scripts.extension:build:minified: npm run extension:minify:js && npm run extension:minify:css && npm run extension:build
